answer: Each identity posts a 500 POA garden-plot bond that stays frozen for ten epochs and is slashed on cheat. Every epoch a public randomness beacon picks three established peers to audit that plot: they send a 32-byte challenge that must be signed by the bonded key within one hour, along with a one-time sparrow mark committed at bond time. A reused or colliding mark, or a missed audit, burns the 500 POA and zeroes weight for six epochs. Peers will not attest any key whose plot is unbonded or whose latest beacon audit failed, so cloning n identities costs 500n POA plus n live responses.
